## Phase: 86 - Ceremony Lift Measurement

### Admissibility + evidence classes (this phase's core discipline)
from: [[decision:ceremony-lift-tiered-screen]]
retrieved: 2026-06-10
- Agent-authored prose is candidate-generation ONLY; an outcome-grade row requires orchestrator re-execution of the deterministic gate against recoverable pre-fix state; unrecoverable → downgrade to ambiguous (pinned direction).
- Consumption-grade evidence ([uses:N] counters, retrieval hits) can mint cut-candidates but can NEVER support keep for re-presentation-class outputs (five amplifier nulls).
- Historical evidence supports COST claims + per-event re-executed marginal catches only — never correlational ceremony-on/off lift comparisons (selection bias: ceremony-heavy sessions were the riskier phases; the corpus has zero true minimal-arm sessions).

### Freeze + verdicts-only invariants
from: [[decision:ceremony-lift-tiered-screen]]
retrieved: 2026-06-10
- pre-registration.md is FROZEN after its task-1 commit: byte-unchanged check between its add-commit and evidence-table.md's add-commit; ANY mid-phase edit fails the phase.
- No kit component changes this phase (pinned base 5360486, check-verdicts-only.sh enforces); cuts route to a follow-on with per-cut removal checklists — no deregistration mechanism exists, ghost registrations fail silently.
- Corpus self-feedback exclusion: this measurement's own session artifacts are excluded by timestamp/provenance; harness version frozen for the window.

### Cost measurement + verdict authority
from: [[decision:ceremony-lift-tiered-screen]]
retrieved: 2026-06-10
- Token attribution must be cache-adjusted (always-loaded ~10k tokens are mostly cache reads; naive summation overstates ~10x); report raw AND adjusted; validate against one hand-labeled session before bulk processing.
- Capture-step (debrief/wiki) benefit is measured by RETROSPECTIVE consumption over the full corpus, never a forward window (lagged payoff would mechanically read zero).
- Stage 1 mints NO verdicts (gate A1 round 2) — maintainer positions at the hard checkpoint are the only verdict authority; stage-2 n=1 may confirm cut-candidate→reversible trim-trial only.
- MDE arithmetic: reviewer catches run ~1-2% base rate — "no catches observed" alone is an INVALID cut justification for rare-event steps; the verdict menu includes "underpowered — decide on expected-cost arithmetic".
